metadata.description: Standalone pronunciation drills — minimal pairs, sound isolation, rhythm, and progressive difficulty (see PRONUNCIATION_MODULE_REVIEW.md Priority 8).

exercises.title: Isolate: dz
exercises.englishAnchor: 'ds' in 'beds' — including at the start of a syllable
exercises.instruction: Say English 'beds' and hold the final 'dz'. Now start a syllable with that same cluster — no vowel before it.

exercises.title: Isolate: mh (breathy m)
exercises.instruction: Hum through closed lips, then open into a breathy 'h' without separating m and h.

exercises.title: Isolate: sv (whistled hiss)
exercises.instruction: Round your lips slightly, then produce a grooved 's' that flows into lip-teeth 'v'. The whistle comes from lip rounding during the friction.

exercises.title: Clean onset: word-initial ng
exercises.note: English speakers often add 'uh' before word-initial ng. Repeat until you can start on the nasal with no lead-in vowel.

exercises.title: Even syllable timing
exercises.instruction: Shona is more syllable-timed than English. Tap a steady beat and give each syllable the same weight — do not smash unstressed syllables.
